meta.title: 来杭州不来虎跑公园我真的会伤心！摄影师私藏的虎跑宝藏机位大公开
meta.title_en: Visit Hangzhou Without Hupao Park? I'd Be Heartbroken! Photographer's Hidden Spots
meta.topic: 摄影教学 · 杭州虎跑公园

scenes.title_cn: 虎跑公园：水山林大门口
scenes.title_en: Hupao Park: The Water-Forest at the Gate
scenes.context: 博主介绍虎跑公园名字的读音争议（虎跑还是虎袍），建议早上7点开门就进园人少，一进门就是一片水山林。语域：讲解口播，带疑问互动。
sentences: 这个公园早上7点就开门了，我会建议大家早点进园，人会少很多。
This park opens at seven in the morning — I'd recommend getting in early when there are far fewer people.
opens at seven（7点开门）；far fewer people（人少很多）
一进门就是一片水山林，可以在这里稍作停留。
Right past the gate is a forest of water and trees — worth stopping by for a while.
a forest of water and trees（水山林）；stop by（稍作停留）
如果是晴天，天很蓝，倒映在池子里面，就会很有那种印象派油画的感觉。
On a sunny day, the blue sky reflects in the pond and gives it that impressionist oil-painting feel.
reflect in the pond（倒映在池中）；impressionist（印象派的）
paraphrase: 稍作停留 → stop by / linger a while
stop by · linger
印象派油画 → impressionist oil painting / Monet-style
impressionist · Monet-style
scenes.speak: This park opens at seven in the morning — I'd recommend getting in early when there are far fewer people. Right past the gate is a forest of water and trees — worth stopping by for a while. On a sunny day, the blue sky reflects in the pond and gives it that impressionist oil-painting feel.

scenes.title_en: Sunny Reflections: A Monet Painting Feel
scenes.context: 博主建议拍局部水面倒影，会很像莫奈的油画。晴天天空蓝、池水清澈，倒影层次丰富。语域：摄影讲解，示范语气。
sentences: 你看这鱼，平常也没有人来捞，对吧。
Look at these fish — no one ever comes to catch them, right?
口语反问：no one ever comes, right?
所以这里如果我们可以去拍一些局部的水面的倒影。
So here we can shoot some close-up reflections on the water.
close-up reflections（局部倒影）
我觉得也会很像那种莫奈的油画的感觉。
I think it would also feel a lot like a Monet painting.
feel like a Monet（很有莫奈的感觉）
paraphrase: 局部倒影 → close-up reflections / details in the water
reflections · details in the water
莫奈油画 → a Monet painting / an impressionist masterpiece
Monet · impressionist masterpiece
scenes.speak: Look at these fish — no one ever comes to catch them, right? So here we can shoot some close-up reflections on the water. I think it would also feel a lot like a Monet painting.

scenes.title_en: Finding Light at the Front Gate: A Tutorial
scenes.context: 博主现场示范拍人像脸黄又绿怎么办，分享一个非常简单的拍照找光方法，调侃摄影老师之魂熊熊燃烧。语域：教程口播，活泼示范。
sentences: 来公园拍照，脸却又黄又绿怎么办？
You come to the park to shoot, but your face looks yellow and green — what do you do?
your face looks yellow and green（脸又黄又绿）；what do you do（怎么办）
今天教大家一个非常简单的拍照找光的方法。
Today I'll teach you a very simple way to find the light for your shots.
find the light（找光）；a simple way to（一个简单的方法）
本来想着早上8点钟进来逛园子，结果撑不住在大门口就先录了一段教程。
I planned to wander the park at 8 a.m., but I couldn't hold back — I ended up filming a tutorial right at the gate.
wander the park（逛园子）；couldn't hold back（撑不住）
paraphrase: 找光 → find the light / work the light to your advantage
find the light · work the light
逛园子 → wander the park / stroll through the garden
wander · stroll
scenes.speak: You come to the park to shoot, but your face looks yellow and green — what do you do? Today I'll teach you a very simple way to find the light for your shots. I planned to wander the park at 8 a.m., but I couldn't hold back — I ended up filming a tutorial right at the gate.

scenes.title_cn: 老虎雕像：大广角峡谷感
scenes.title_en: The Tiger Statues: Wide-Angle Canyon Vibe
scenes.context: 两只老虎刨地动作的雕塑是韩美林创作的，也是虎跑公园名字的由来。博主示范用广角镜头从下往上拍，会有峡谷般的感觉。语域：摄影示范，现场指导。
sentences: 它就是两只老虎刨地的这样一个动作，也就是虎跑公园名字的由来。
It's two tigers in a pawing-the-ground pose — that's where the park's name comes from.
a pawing-the-ground pose（刨地的动作）；the origin of the name（名字的由来）
你直接用这个广角镜头在这拍，会有那种峡谷的感觉。
Just use a wide-angle lens here and you get that canyon feel.
a wide-angle lens（广角镜头）；canyon feel（峡谷感）
你挡着我光了，我是大广角。
You're blocking my light — I'm on the big wide-angle.
block my light（挡光）；on the wide-angle（用广角）
paraphrase: 名字的由来 → where the name comes from / how the park got its name
origin of the name · got its name
峡谷感 → canyon feel / a sense of depth
canyon feel · sense of depth
scenes.speak: It's two tigers in a pawing-the-ground pose — that's where the park's name comes from. Just use a wide-angle lens here and you get that canyon feel. You're blocking my light — I'm on the big wide-angle.

scenes.title_en: The Stone Turtle at Bixi: The Dragon's Son
scenes.context: 两只看上去像乌龟的雕像其实是龙子霸下，正确答案是「碧溪」（bi xi）。博主还介绍了康熙乾隆南巡必喝的虎跑泉水。语域：人文科普，带趣味问答。
sentences: 这里有两个看上去是乌龟的雕像，但其实是念碧溪。
There are two statues that look like turtles, but the name is actually read Bixi.
look like turtles（看上去像乌龟）；read Bixi（念碧溪）
就是龙子，那个乌龟。
It's the dragon's son — the turtle-like creature.
the dragon's son（龙子）
它这里写着康熙乾隆南巡杭州的时候，都会指定要喝虎跑泉。
It says here that when Kangxi and Qianlong toured Hangzhou, they'd specifically drink the Hupao spring water.
tour Hangzhou（南巡杭州）；specifically drink（指定要喝）
paraphrase: 看上去像 → look like / resemble
look like · resemble
南巡 → tour the south / make a royal tour
tour the south · royal tour
scenes.speak: There are two statues that look like turtles, but the name is actually read Bixi. It's the dragon's son — the turtle-like creature. It says here that when Kangxi and Qianlong toured Hangzhou, they'd specifically drink the Hupao spring water.

scenes.context: 博主习惯在拍园林时找前景做留白：拍亭子时左侧故意留很多枫叶并虚化，产生留白意境；枫叶像画框一样给主体留出空间。语域：摄影构图讲解。
sentences: 我每次来拍这种园林，我都会习惯性地去找一些前景。
Whenever I shoot this kind of garden, I make a habit of looking for some foreground.
look for foreground（找前景）；make a habit of（习惯性做…）
拍这个亭子，我就会左侧故意去留很多的枫叶，然后把它虚掉。
For this pavilion, I deliberately leave a lot of maple leaves on the left and blur them out.
deliberately leave（故意留）；blur them out（把它虚掉）
它那个枫叶就有点像画框一样，正好给这个留出来。
The maple leaves act almost like a picture frame, leaving just the right space for it.
act like a picture frame（像画框一样）；leave space（留出空间）
paraphrase: 找前景 → look for foreground / use foreground elements
foreground · foreground elements
像画框 → act like a picture frame / frame the subject
picture frame · frame the subject
scenes.speak: Whenever I shoot this kind of garden, I make a habit of looking for some foreground. For this pavilion, I deliberately leave a lot of maple leaves on the left and blur them out. The maple leaves act almost like a picture frame, leaving just the right space for it.

scenes.context: 博主示范拍窗景：错误示范是用大广角怼近拍导致内外光比失衡、窗外过曝；正确做法是退远一点用中长焦、压暗曝光，拍剪影让窗外正常曝光。语域：摄影教程，正误对比。
sentences: 拍窗景一个错误示范，就是用大广角这么怼近了拍。
Here's a common mistake when shooting a window view — going in too close with a wide-angle lens.
a common mistake（常见错误）；too close（怼得太近）
我们像内外光比不是很大吗，那如果我脸要亮的话，窗外就过曝了对吧。
The light ratio inside and outside is huge — if I want my face bright, the window blows out, right?
light ratio（光比）；blow out（过曝）
正确的做法是你退远一点，用中长焦段，然后压暗曝光。
The right way is to back up, use a medium telephoto, and underexpose.
back up（退远）；medium telephoto（中长焦段）；underexpose（压暗曝光）
paraphrase: 过曝 → blow out / overexposed
blow out · overexposed
拍剪影 → shoot a silhouette / make it a silhouette shot
silhouette · silhouette shot
scenes.speak: Here's a common mistake when shooting a window view — going in too close with a wide-angle lens. The light ratio inside and outside is huge — if I want my face bright, the window blows out, right? The right way is to back up, use a medium telephoto, and underexpose — my face goes into shadow and we shoot a silhouette while the window is properly exposed.

scenes.title_en: Back Up a Bit and Shoot
scenes.context: 博主总结这次虎跑公园的轻量级又出片路线：早上进园逛一圈大概两个小时，从水山林、虎跑泉、李叔同纪念馆到罗汉堂，全程都有宝藏机位。语域：收尾总结，轻松道别。
sentences: 从中楼下来附近溜达一下，差不多就可以下山了。
After the tower, you can wander around nearby and then head back down the hill.
wander around（溜达）；head back down（下山）
这样一趟逛下来，怎么也得要两个小时左右。
A full trip around here takes a good two hours or so.
a full trip（一趟）；two hours or so（两个小时左右）
我觉得算是一个轻量级又出片的路线。
I'd say it's a light, photo-worthy route.
photo-worthy（出片）；a light route（轻量级路线）
paraphrase: 溜达一下 → wander around / take a stroll
wander around · stroll
下山 → head back down / walk down the hill
head down · walk down
scenes.speak: After the tower, you can wander around nearby and then head back down the hill. All in all, this route takes about two hours. I think it's a light, photo-worthy route — I'd say it's a hidden gem. See you in the next one!

practice: The park opens at seven — come early and there are far fewer people.
讲解如何用广角拍出峡谷感
Use a wide-angle lens from below and you get that canyon feel.
Leave some maple leaves in the foreground and blur them out for negative space.
解释窗景拍摄的正确做法
Back up, use a telephoto, underexpose, and shoot a silhouette.
pitfalls: The park opens at seven in the morning.
第三人称单数一般现在时 opens 要加 -s；主语 the park 是单数。
wide-angle 是复合形容词需要连字符；lens 是可数名词前要有冠词 a/an。
blow out 是动词短语表示「过曝」；overexposure 是名词，不能直接作谓语。
The leaves look like a frame.
The maple leaves act like a picture frame.
act like（起…作用）比 look like（看起来像）更准确，因为树叶确实充当了画框的功能。
shifts: 用 out of this world（绝了）、photo-worthy（出片）、stunning 更精准
用 impressionist（印象派）、a Monet painting（莫奈油画）、lush（绿油油）
用 far fewer people（人少很多）、crowded（拥挤）、tourists
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：湖袍/狐跑/虎袍→虎跑、河野池→荷塘、韩美玲→韩美林、韩徽亭→含晖亭、李书彤/李叔彤→李叔同、封子凯→丰子恺、潘天秀→潘天寿、罗汉堂→罗汉堂、碧溪→赑屃、龙子→龙子、玉带池→玉带池等。
